title: Ukrainian Cherry Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring fermented dough and sweet glace cherries, perfect for kids and whole30 friendly, these chewy dumplings are steamed in leaf wraps to create a delicious and healthy snack, the fermentation process gives the dough a unique flavor and texture
instructions: In a large bowl, combine warm water and yeast, letting it sit for 5 minutes to activate the yeast.
Add flour, salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough ferment in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a glace cherry in the center.
Fold the dough over the cherry to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Wrap each dumpling in a large leaf, making sure to cover the entire dumpling.
Place the wrapped dumplings in a steamer basket and steam for 15 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot, with the leaf wraps still intact.
